text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Wait, we're watching a horror movie now?
I wanna watch, I wanna watch~!

text_block_list.name: Ritto Dorm Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Thank goodness!
With this many of us together, there's nothing to be afraid of, right!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"No problem, no problem!
We can totally wing it~!"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
W-What was that—wait, it was just my smartphone dropping!
Don't scare me like that~~!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Who said we could just "wing it"?!
There are some things you CAN'T just wing!!
